description: Multinational organization relies on Binding Corporate Rules (BCRs) for intra-group transfers but BCRs have not been approved by competent supervisory authority. Article 47 requires BCR approval.
applicability: Applicable to multinational groups transferring data between entities in different countries. BCRs must be approved by lead supervisory authority and meet Article 47 requirements.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of intra-group transfer mechanisms and absence of approved BCR documentation or supervisory authority approval.
